anomalies.description: A person in camouflage is actively firing a submachine gun, with visible muzzle flash and smoke at frame f10 (5.0s).

A sustained physical confrontation occurs: one man (The Rock) engages two armed assailants in close-quarters combat, involving grappling, takedowns, and disarming; includes visible strikes and struggle on the ground.

After subduing opponents, the bald man grabs a masked assailant by the throat and lifts him off the ground, holding him in a chokehold while the victim is clearly incapacitated and unable to resist.; After subduing an opponent, the bald man forcefully pushes or throws a subdued, masked individual against a wall or structure, indicating post-combat mistreatment of a helpless victim.
The bald man releases the chokehold and continues to physically control the same assailant, pushing him against a wall and delivering a final strike before moving away.
A woman in a tank top is seen running down stairs while being pursued or engaged by another person; motion blur and body positioning suggest a physical chase or struggle occurring on the staircase.
